notes: Eight bowls; nutrition is for 1/8 of the batch. Finished weight and volume are unmeasured.
Uses about 1.1 kg peeled potatoes, one medium onion, 2 medium carrots, 3 cups whole milk, 2 tbsp unsalted butter, and water. Optional meat is excluded.
Peeled-potato nutrients come from Health Canada’s Canadian Nutrient File; other ingredients use USDA records.
Includes ½ tsp salt. Unmeasured pepper is excluded; more salt or stock changes sodium.
